purpose: La Liga (esp.1 / KXLALIGA*) provider research for the feat-la-liga branch — every claim below was probed live on 2026-07-28 and the raw responses are archived beside this file as laliga_*_2026-07-28.json.

scoreboard.note: same event shape as usa.1 — parse_event applies unchanged

standings.preseason_state: ONE child ('2026-27 LALIGA') carrying 20 entries whose every stat is 0 and whose ranks are a clean 1..20 — NOT an empty payload. Rendering it through the MLS parser produces a plausible-looking all-zero table, which is exactly the fabricated-zero-row surface the frontend rules forbid. The La Liga layer therefore suppresses tables in which every row has gamesPlayed==0 and reports preseason=true instead.

match_summary.lastFiveGames: present, same fields as usa.1 including the WINNER-FIRST `score` string trap: Alavés' 2-4 home loss to ATH arrives as score='4-2' while homeTeamScore=2/awayTeamScore=4/atVs='vs' — the derive-from-scores discipline applies unchanged
match_summary.seasonseries: present (the H2H shape ESPN renamed to on Jul 24)
match_summary.boxscore_team_stats: richer than usa.1 (passes/tackles/crosses/clearances) and a superset of the MLS STAT_ORDER keys
match_summary.boxscore_xg: NO xG-like field exists (checked every stat name for xg/expected)
match_summary.rosters: per-match participants present with per-player stats (goals/assists/shots/cards/GK saves) — the transfer-stale team-roster endpoint is NOT needed

kalshi.throttle: all probes spaced >=0.35s (repo rule — Kalshi 429s tight loops)

game_series.title: La Liga Game
game_series.historical_season: 2025-26 (380 fixtures + a 'Real Madrid: Game Winner?' title anomaly worth defending against)

kalshi.unverifiable_bridges: Deportivo La Coruña, Málaga, Racing Santander are newly promoted and appear in NO historical Kalshi event — their Kalshi names cannot be curated until the venue lists them. They stay unmapped and the unmapped-upcoming metric reports them; guessing a name is exactly the KXMENWORLDCUP class of error.

family_series_probe.futures: KXLALIGA exists (title 'LA LIGA', frequency annual) — the KXMLSCUP analogue. KXLALIGACUP and KXLALIGAWINNER 404.
family_series_probe.honesty: series EXISTENCE is verified; 2026-27 market COVERAGE is not — zero open events today. The series tickers ship as config with a discovery probe, and nothing renders until events actually open.

xg_sources.conclusion: NO trustworthy public xG source exists for La Liga as of 2026-07-28 — the La Liga model scaffold ships WITHOUT xG ratings (goals-only, the MLS xg_alpha=0 path).
xg_sources.espn_esp1: no xG field anywhere in the completed-match boxscore (verified event 748506)
xg_sources.laliga_official: apim.laliga.com answers 401 'missing subscription key' — subscription-gated, no public no-auth plane (unlike MLS's stats-api.mlssoccer.com Sportec feed)
xg_sources.understat: HTTP 200 but an 18KB shell without the teamsData payload under a plain client — HTML scraping of a third party's model estimates, no API contract; this repo has been burned by silent provider drift on REAL APIs (ESPN score winner-first, headToHeadGames rename), so an unversioned scrape is not a trustworthy evidence substrate
xg_sources.fbref_opta: NOT probed — bulk scraping is against their terms; no API
xg_sources.api_football: NOT VERIFIED — the free plan is season-blind for current seasons (memory: verify club-season visibility before relying on it) and no key was available to this session; xG availability for La Liga on the free tier remains an open question for Son
xg_sources.rule_applied: never fabricate or approximate xG parity — absence documented, not papered over
